description: Claude-Code-style coding tools that operate on the engineering agent's sandboxed project workspace.

tools.name: fs_write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file in the project workspace with the given content. Use for new files or full rewrites.

path.description: Relative path within the workspace, e.g. 'index.html' or 'src/app.js'

tools.name: fs_read_file
tools.description: Read the contents of a file in the project workspace.

tools.name: fs_edit_file
tools.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact unique string. old_string must appear exactly once.

old_string.description: The exact text to replace (must be unique in the file)

tools.name: fs_list_files
tools.description: List all files in the project workspace (excludes node_modules and .git).

tools.name: fs_search
tools.description: Search the workspace files for a substring; returns matching file/line/text.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command in the workspace (e.g. 'npm install', 'npm run build', 'npm test'). Only allowlisted base commands run; output and errors are returned.

command.description: The full command to run, e.g. 'npm install' or 'npm run build'
